answer: Epoch 122: anchor every agent identity to one priced, public stake that cannot be split across copies — each clone pays fresh collateral, so a sybil flood buys no cheap entry. Then thread that stake through countersigned work: an agent only earns trade rights by completing verified tasks attested by established peers, and a single orchard of shared reputation means one bad deed poisons every branch of the same identity. Clones pay full price and still inherit the same tainted history, so cloning stops paying.
